svg.title: What a failed PreToolUse command hook does in Claude Code 2.1.295, with and without onFailure block
svg.desc: Results of a test on October 9, 2026 with Claude Code 2.1.295 and a PreToolUse command hook on Bash. Without onFailure, the touch command ran when the hook script did not exist, when the hook exited 1, and when the hook passed its 3 second timeout. With onFailure set to block, the command was blocked in all three cases. When the hook exited 0, the command ran in both setups.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, sans-serif
